items.question: Trong câu "Can a cleverer comparison sort reach O(n)?", từ "clever" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can a cleverer comparison sort reach O(n)?", what does "clever" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: clever /ˈklev.ər/ (tính từ): khéo léo, thông minh. Dạng so sánh hơn là "cleverer"; "a clever trick" = một mẹo hay.
items.explanationEn: clever /ˈklev.ər/ (adjective): smart, well designed. The comparative form is "cleverer"; "a clever trick" is a smart shortcut.

items.question: Trong câu "Each internal node is one comparison; each leaf is one final ordering of the input.", từ "internal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each internal node is one comparison; each leaf is one final ordering of the input.", what does "internal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (tính từ): nằm bên trong. "Internal node" = nút trong (có con), trái với "leaf" (nút lá).
items.explanationEn: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (adjective): located inside. An "internal node" has children, unlike a "leaf" node.

items.question: Trong câu "Each internal node is one comparison; each leaf is one final ordering of the input.", từ "leaf" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each internal node is one comparison; each leaf is one final ordering of the input.", what does "leaf" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the top node of a tree
a green part of a plant
items.explanation: leaf /liːf/ (danh từ): nút lá (không có con). Số nhiều là "leaves"; trong cây dữ liệu, lá là nút cuối cùng.
items.explanationEn: leaf /liːf/ (noun): a node with no children. The plural is "leaves"; in a data tree a leaf is an end node.

items.question: Trong câu "The argument in three steps:", từ "argument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The argument in three steps:", what does "argument" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a value passed to a function
items.explanation: argument /ˈɑːɡ.jə.mənt/ (danh từ): lập luận, chứng minh. "Argument" còn có nghĩa là tham số hàm; ở đây là chuỗi lập luận.
items.explanationEn: argument /ˈɑːɡ.jə.mənt/ (noun): a line of reasoning. "Argument" can also mean a function parameter; here it is a chain of reasoning.

items.question: Trong câu "The input could be in any of n! orders, and each needs a different sequence of moves, so the tree needs at least n! leaves.", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The input could be in any of n! orders, and each needs a different sequence of moves, so the tree needs at least n! leaves.", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (danh từ): chuỗi, dãy nối tiếp. "A sequence of steps" = một chuỗi các bước theo thứ tự.
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (noun): an ordered series. "A sequence of steps" is a series of steps in a fixed order.

items.question: Trong câu "The input could be in any of n! orders, and each needs a different sequence of moves, so the tree needs at least n! leaves.", từ "at least" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The input could be in any of n! orders, and each needs a different sequence of moves, so the tree needs at least n! leaves.", what does "at least" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at least /æt ˈliːst/ (cụm từ): ít nhất, tối thiểu. Trái nghĩa là "at most" (nhiều nhất); hay gặp khi nói về chặn dưới.
items.explanationEn: at least /æt ˈliːst/ (phrase): no fewer than. The opposite is "at most"; common when describing a lower bound.

items.question: Trong câu "So every comparison sort needs Ω(n log n) comparisons in the worst case (and on average too).", từ "worst case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So every comparison sort needs Ω(n log n) comparisons in the worst case (and on average too).", what does "worst case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp xấu nhất. "In the worst case" = trong trường hợp xấu nhất; đi cùng "best case", "average case".
items.explanationEn: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (phrase): the least favourable input. "In the worst case" pairs with "best case" and "average case".

items.question: Trong câu "Merge sort and heap sort are therefore asymptotically optimal among comparison sorts.", từ "asymptotically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Merge sort and heap sort are therefore asymptotically optimal among comparison sorts.", what does "asymptotically" (adverb) mean?
options: xét về bộ nhớ sử dụng
xét về tiệm cận (n rất lớn)
items.explanation: asymptotically /ˌæs.ɪmˈtɒt.ɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): xét về tiệm cận (n rất lớn). "Asymptotically optimal" = tối ưu khi n tiến tới rất lớn, bỏ qua hằng số.
items.explanationEn: asymptotically /ˌæs.ɪmˈtɒt.ɪ.kli/ (adverb): as n grows very large. "Asymptotically optimal" means best possible as n grows, ignoring constants.

items.question: Trong câu "Merge sort and heap sort are therefore asymptotically optimal among comparison sorts.", từ "optimal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Merge sort and heap sort are therefore asymptotically optimal among comparison sorts.", what does "optimal" (adjective) mean?
options: tối ưu, tốt nhất có thể
items.explanation: optimal /ˈɒp.tɪ.məl/ (tính từ): tối ưu, tốt nhất có thể. Đừng nhầm với "optional" (tùy chọn); danh từ là "optimum".
items.explanationEn: optimal /ˈɒp.tɪ.məl/ (adjective): the best possible. Do not confuse it with "optional"; the noun is "optimum".

items.question: Trong câu "This does not contradict insertion sort being O(n) on an already sorted array: the bound is about the worst case over all inputs, not about lucky inputs.", từ "contradict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This does not contradict insertion sort being O(n) on an already sorted array: the bound is about the worst case over all inputs, not about lucky inputs.", what does "contradict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contradict /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪkt/ (động từ): mâu thuẫn với. Danh từ là "contradiction"; "X does not contradict Y" = X không mâu thuẫn với Y.
items.explanationEn: contradict /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪkt/ (verb): to be in conflict with. The noun is "contradiction"; "X does not contradict Y" means they are consistent.

items.question: Trong câu "This does not contradict insertion sort being O(n) on an already sorted array: the bound is about the worst case over all inputs, not about lucky inputs.", từ "bound" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This does not contradict insertion sort being O(n) on an already sorted array: the bound is about the worst case over all inputs, not about lucky inputs.", what does "bound" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bound /baʊnd/ (danh từ): giới hạn, cận. "Lower bound" = cận dưới, "upper bound" = cận trên.
items.explanationEn: bound /baʊnd/ (noun): a limit on a value. "Lower bound" and "upper bound" are the minimum and maximum limits.

items.question: Trong câu "The bound only applies to algorithms that learn about the data only through comparisons.", từ "apply to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The bound only applies to algorithms that learn about the data only through comparisons.", what does "apply to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: apply to /əˈplaɪ tuː/ (cụm từ): áp dụng cho. "The rule applies to X" = quy tắc có hiệu lực với X.
items.explanationEn: apply to /əˈplaɪ tuː/ (phrase): to be relevant to. "The rule applies to X" means the rule is valid for X.

items.question: Trong câu "If the keys are integers in a small range or have a fixed number of digits, we can use them directly as array indices and never compare.", từ "range" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the keys are integers in a small range or have a fixed number of digits, we can use them directly as array indices and never compare.", what does "range" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: range /reɪndʒ/ (danh từ): khoảng giá trị. "In the range 0 to 100" = trong khoảng từ 0 đến 100.
items.explanationEn: range /reɪndʒ/ (noun): a span of values. "In the range 0 to 100" means between 0 and 100.

items.question: Trong câu "If the keys are integers in a small range or have a fixed number of digits, we can use them directly as array indices and never compare.", từ "index" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the keys are integers in a small range or have a fixed number of digits, we can use them directly as array indices and never compare.", what does "index" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a list at the end of a book
items.explanation: index /ˈɪn.deks/ (danh từ): chỉ số vị trí. Số nhiều là "indices" hoặc "indexes"; "array index" = chỉ số phần tử mảng.
items.explanationEn: index /ˈɪn.deks/ (noun): a position number. The plural is "indices" or "indexes"; an "array index" locates an element.

items.question: Trong câu "The price is generality (no custom comparators) and extra memory for counts or buckets.", từ "price" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The price is generality (no custom comparators) and extra memory for counts or buckets.", what does "price" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: price /praɪs/ (danh từ): cái giá phải đánh đổi. "The price is X" = cái giá phải trả (nghĩa bóng) là X.
items.explanationEn: price /praɪs/ (noun): what you give up. "The price is X" figuratively means X is the sacrifice you make.

items.question: Trong câu "The price is generality (no custom comparators) and extra memory for counts or buckets.", từ "generality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The price is generality (no custom comparators) and extra memory for counts or buckets.", what does "generality" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: generality /ˌdʒen.əˈræl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính tổng quát. Tính từ là "general"; thuật toán tổng quát dùng được cho nhiều loại dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: generality /ˌdʒen.əˈræl.ə.ti/ (noun): broad applicability. The adjective is "general"; a general algorithm works on many kinds of data.

items.question: Trong câu "The price is generality (no custom comparators) and extra memory for counts or buckets.", từ "custom" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The price is generality (no custom comparators) and extra memory for counts or buckets.", what does "custom" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: custom /ˈkʌs.təm/ (tính từ): tùy chỉnh theo nhu cầu. "Custom comparator" = hàm so sánh do người dùng tự viết.
items.explanationEn: custom /ˈkʌs.təm/ (adjective): made to your needs. A "custom comparator" is a comparison function you write yourself.

items.question: Trong câu "Complexity: time O(n + k) — one pass over the n items and one pass over the k + 1 counters.", từ "pass" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Complexity: time O(n + k) — one pass over the n items and one pass over the k + 1 counters.", what does "pass" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pass /pɑːs/ (danh từ): một lượt duyệt. "One pass over the array" = duyệt qua mảng một lần.
items.explanationEn: pass /pɑːs/ (noun): one full traversal. "One pass over the array" means going through it once.

items.question: Trong câu "Great for ages (0–120), scores (0–100) or bytes (0–255); terrible for 1,000 numbers up to 10⁹, where the counts array needs a billion slots.", từ "slot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Great for ages (0–120), scores (0–100) or bytes (0–255); terrible for 1,000 numbers up to 10⁹, where the counts array needs a billion slots.", what does "slot" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a place to hold a value
items.explanation: slot /slɒt/ (danh từ): ô chứa, vị trí. "A billion slots" = một tỷ ô trong mảng.
items.explanationEn: slot /slɒt/ (noun): a place to hold a value. "A billion slots" means a billion positions in the array.

items.question: Trong câu "When k ≫ n, k dominates.", từ "dominate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When k ≫ n, k dominates.", what does "dominate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dominate /ˈdɒm.ɪ.neɪt/ (động từ): chiếm ưu thế, lấn át. Trong Big O, số hạng "dominates" là số hạng quyết định tốc độ tăng.
items.explanationEn: dominate /ˈdɒm.ɪ.neɪt/ (verb): to be the main factor. In Big O, the dominant term decides how fast the cost grows.

items.question: Trong câu "To sort records by a key and keep equal keys in their original order, use prefix sums and fill the output from the back:", từ "record" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To sort records by a key and keep equal keys in their original order, use prefix sums and fill the output from the back:", what does "record" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: record /ˈrek.ɔːd/ (danh từ): bản ghi dữ liệu. Động từ "record" đọc là /rɪˈkɔːd/; danh từ nhấn âm đầu.
items.explanationEn: record /ˈrek.ɔːd/ (noun): a stored data entry. The verb is pronounced /rɪˈkɔːd/; the noun stresses the first syllable.

items.question: Trong câu "To sort records by a key and keep equal keys in their original order, use prefix sums and fill the output from the back:", từ "original" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To sort records by a key and keep equal keys in their original order, use prefix sums and fill the output from the back:", what does "original" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: original /əˈrɪdʒ.ən.əl/ (tính từ): ban đầu, lúc đầu. "Original order" = thứ tự ban đầu trước khi sắp xếp.
items.explanationEn: original /əˈrɪdʒ.ən.əl/ (adjective): as it was at first. "Original order" is the order before sorting.

items.question: Trong câu "It exploits the fact that information about a number's size is encoded in its digits: more digits means a bigger number, and at equal length the higher place values decide.", từ "exploit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It exploits the fact that information about a number's size is encoded in its digits: more digits means a bigger number, and at equal length the higher place values decide.", what does "exploit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exploit /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/ (động từ): tận dụng, khai thác. "Exploit the fact that..." = tận dụng việc...; trong bảo mật, "exploit" là khai thác lỗ hổng.
items.explanationEn: exploit /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/ (verb): to make good use of. "Exploit the fact that..." means take advantage of it; in security it means abuse a flaw.

items.question: Trong câu "It exploits the fact that information about a number's size is encoded in its digits: more digits means a bigger number, and at equal length the higher place values decide.", từ "encode" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It exploits the fact that information about a number's size is encoded in its digits: more digits means a bigger number, and at equal length the higher place values decide.", what does "encode" (verb) mean?
options: được thể hiện, mã hóa vào
items.explanation: encode /ɪnˈkəʊd/ (động từ): được thể hiện, mã hóa vào. Trái nghĩa là "decode"; "information is encoded in X" = thông tin nằm sẵn trong X.
items.explanationEn: encode /ɪnˈkəʊd/ (verb): to represent in a form. The opposite is "decode"; "encoded in X" means X carries the information.

items.question: Trong câu "It exploits the fact that information about a number's size is encoded in its digits: more digits means a bigger number, and at equal length the higher place values decide.", từ "place value" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It exploits the fact that information about a number's size is encoded in its digits: more digits means a bigger number, and at equal length the higher place values decide.", what does "place value" (phrase) mean?
options: giá trị theo hàng chữ số
items.explanation: place value /ˈpleɪs ˌvæl.juː/ (cụm từ): giá trị theo hàng chữ số. Hàng đơn vị, chục, trăm... là các "place values" (ones, tens, hundreds).
items.explanationEn: place value /ˈpleɪs ˌvæl.juː/ (phrase): a digit's positional worth. Ones, tens and hundreds are place values.

items.question: Trong câu "Put each number into the bucket for its ones digit, keeping arrival order.", từ "arrival" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Put each number into the bucket for its ones digit, keeping arrival order.", what does "arrival" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: arrival /əˈraɪ.vəl/ (danh từ): sự đến nơi. "Arrival order" = thứ tự phần tử đến (được đưa vào).
items.explanationEn: arrival /əˈraɪ.vəl/ (noun): the act of coming. "Arrival order" is the order in which items came in.

items.question: Trong câu "Make 10 buckets, one per digit 0–9.", từ "bucket" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Make 10 buckets, one per digit 0–9.", what does "bucket" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bucket /ˈbʌk.ɪt/ (danh từ): ngăn chứa nhóm phần tử. Trong thuật toán, "bucket" là danh sách tạm chứa phần tử cùng nhóm.
items.explanationEn: bucket /ˈbʌk.ɪt/ (noun): a group holding items. In algorithms, a bucket is a temporary list for items of one group.

items.question: Trong câu "Each pass keeps the previous order among numbers with the same current digit, so the lower digits break ties correctly.", từ "break ties" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each pass keeps the previous order among numbers with the same current digit, so the lower digits break ties correctly.", what does "break ties" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: break ties /breɪk taɪz/ (cụm từ): phân định khi bằng nhau. "Tie-breaker" = tiêu chí phụ để phân định khi hai phần tử bằng nhau.
items.explanationEn: break ties /breɪk taɪz/ (phrase): to decide between equals. A "tie-breaker" is the extra rule used when two items are equal.

items.question: Trong câu "Three small helpers make the implementation readable.", từ "helper" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three small helpers make the implementation readable.", what does "helper" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: helper /ˈhel.pər/ (danh từ): hàm phụ trợ. "Helper function" = hàm nhỏ tách ra để code chính gọn hơn.
items.explanationEn: helper /ˈhel.pər/ (noun): a small support function. A "helper function" is split out to keep the main code clean.

items.question: Trong câu "Three small helpers make the implementation readable.", từ "readable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three small helpers make the implementation readable.", what does "readable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: readable /ˈriː.də.bəl/ (tính từ): dễ đọc, dễ hiểu. Danh từ là "readability"; "readable code" = mã dễ đọc.
items.explanationEn: readable /ˈriː.də.bəl/ (adjective): easy to read. The noun is "readability"; "readable code" is easy to follow.

items.question: Trong câu "The num === 0 guard matters: Math.log10(0) is -Infinity, so without it the function returns -Infinity.", từ "guard" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The num === 0 guard matters: Math.log10(0) is -Infinity, so without it the function returns -Infinity.", what does "guard" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: guard /ɡɑːd/ (danh từ): câu kiểm tra chặn trước. "Guard clause" = câu if kiểm tra sớm để thoát khỏi hàm.
items.explanationEn: guard /ɡɑːd/ (noun): an early safety check. A "guard clause" is an early if that exits the function.

items.question: Trong câu "Also beware floating point for huge values: Math.log10(999999999999999) rounds to 15, giving 16 digits instead of 15.", từ "beware" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also beware floating point for huge values: Math.log10(999999999999999) rounds to 15, giving 16 digits instead of 15.", what does "beware" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: beware /bɪˈweər/ (động từ): hãy cẩn thận với. Thường dùng ở dạng mệnh lệnh: "Beware of X" = coi chừng X.
items.explanationEn: beware /bɪˈweər/ (verb): to watch out for. Usually imperative: "Beware of X" means be careful about X.

items.question: Trong câu "Also beware floating point for huge values: Math.log10(999999999999999) rounds to 15, giving 16 digits instead of 15.", từ "round" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also beware floating point for huge values: Math.log10(999999999999999) rounds to 15, giving 16 digits instead of 15.", what does "round" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to change to a nearby whole number
items.explanation: round /raʊnd/ (động từ): làm tròn số. "Round up/down" = làm tròn lên/xuống; "rounds to 15" = được làm tròn thành 15.
items.explanationEn: round /raʊnd/ (verb): to change to a nearby whole number. "Round up/down" moves to the next or previous whole number.

items.question: Trong câu "For integers, String(Math.abs(num)).length is a safe alternative.", từ "alternative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For integers, String(Math.abs(num)).length is a safe alternative.", what does "alternative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alternative /ɒlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (danh từ): phương án thay thế. "A safe alternative to X" = cách thay thế an toàn cho X.
items.explanationEn: alternative /ɒlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (noun): another option. "A safe alternative to X" is another option that avoids X's risks.

items.question: Trong câu "In each iteration, create fresh buckets 0–9 and place each number in the bucket for its k-th digit.", từ "iteration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In each iteration, create fresh buckets 0–9 and place each number in the bucket for its k-th digit.", what does "iteration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): một lần lặp. Động từ là "iterate"; "each iteration" = mỗi vòng lặp.
items.explanationEn: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): one run of a loop. The verb is "iterate"; "each iteration" is each time the loop body runs.

items.question: Trong câu "In each iteration, create fresh buckets 0–9 and place each number in the bucket for its k-th digit.", từ "fresh" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In each iteration, create fresh buckets 0–9 and place each number in the bucket for its k-th digit.", what does "fresh" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fresh /freʃ/ (tính từ): mới tinh, chưa dùng. "Fresh copy" = bản sao mới hoàn toàn, không chứa dữ liệu cũ.
items.explanationEn: fresh /freʃ/ (adjective): new and unused. A "fresh copy" is a brand-new one with no old data.

items.question: Trong câu "Buckets created once, outside the k loop — earlier passes' numbers stay in them and the array fills with duplicates.", từ "duplicate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Buckets created once, outside the k loop — earlier passes' numbers stay in them and the array fills with duplicates.", what does "duplicate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (danh từ): phần tử bị trùng lặp. Động từ "duplicate" đọc /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/; "remove duplicates" = loại bỏ phần tử trùng.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (noun): a repeated item. The verb is /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/; "remove duplicates" means drop repeated items.

items.question: Trong câu "new Array(10).fill([]) — all 10 slots share the same array, so every number lands in one bucket.", từ "share" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "new Array(10).fill([]) — all 10 slots share the same array, so every number lands in one bucket.", what does "share" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: share /ʃeər/ (động từ): dùng chung. "Share the same reference" = cùng trỏ tới một đối tượng.
items.explanationEn: share /ʃeər/ (verb): to use the same thing. "Share the same reference" means point to one object.

items.question: Trong câu "new Array(10).fill([]) — all 10 slots share the same array, so every number lands in one bucket.", từ "land" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "new Array(10).fill([]) — all 10 slots share the same array, so every number lands in one bucket.", what does "land" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: land /lænd/ (động từ): rơi vào, kết thúc ở. "Land in X" (nghĩa bóng) = cuối cùng nằm ở X.
items.explanationEn: land /lænd/ (verb): to end up in. Figuratively, "land in X" means to end up in X.

items.question: Trong câu "Not reassigning nums — buckets are built and thrown away; the array never changes.", từ "reassign" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not reassigning nums — buckets are built and thrown away; the array never changes.", what does "reassign" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move to a new post
items.explanation: reassign /ˌriː.əˈsaɪn/ (động từ): gán lại giá trị. Biến khai báo bằng "const" không thể "reassign".
items.explanationEn: reassign /ˌriː.əˈsaɪn/ (verb): to assign a new value. A variable declared with "const" cannot be reassigned.

items.question: Trong câu "Not reassigning nums — buckets are built and thrown away; the array never changes.", từ "throw away" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not reassigning nums — buckets are built and thrown away; the array never changes.", what does "throw away" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: throw away /θrəʊ əˈweɪ/ (cụm từ): vứt bỏ, bỏ đi. Khác với "throw an error" (ném lỗi); "throw away" = bỏ đi vì không dùng.
items.explanationEn: throw away /θrəʊ əˈweɪ/ (phrase): to discard. Unlike "throw an error", "throw away" means discard as unused.

items.question: Trong câu "There are k passes, and each pass visits all n numbers plus the b = 10 buckets: O(k · (n + b)) = O(nk) for a fixed base.", từ "visit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There are k passes, and each pass visits all n numbers plus the b = 10 buckets: O(k · (n + b)) = O(nk) for a fixed base.", what does "visit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: visit /ˈvɪz.ɪt/ (động từ): duyệt qua, xử lý. "Visit every node" = duyệt qua mọi nút.
items.explanationEn: visit /ˈvɪz.ɪt/ (verb): to process in turn. "Visit every node" means process each node once.

items.question: Trong câu "There are k passes, and each pass visits all n numbers plus the b = 10 buckets: O(k · (n + b)) = O(nk) for a fixed base.", từ "base" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There are k passes, and each pass visits all n numbers plus the b = 10 buckets: O(k · (n + b)) = O(nk) for a fixed base.", what does "base" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: base /beɪs/ (danh từ): cơ số (hệ đếm). "Base 10" = hệ thập phân, "base 2" = hệ nhị phân.
items.explanationEn: base /beɪs/ (noun): a number system's radix. "Base 10" is decimal; "base 2" is binary.

items.question: Trong câu "If the numbers are bounded (e.g. 32-bit), k is a constant and radix sort is linear.", từ "bounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the numbers are bounded (e.g. 32-bit), k is a constant and radix sort is linear.", what does "bounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bounded /ˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (tính từ): bị giới hạn. "Bounded by X" = không vượt quá X; trái nghĩa "unbounded".
items.explanationEn: bounded /ˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (adjective): limited in size. "Bounded by X" means never exceeding X; the opposite is "unbounded".

items.question: Trong câu "But n distinct numbers have a maximum of at least n − 1, so k ≥ log₁₀ n and O(nk) is no better than O(n log n).", từ "distinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But n distinct numbers have a maximum of at least n − 1, so k ≥ log₁₀ n and O(nk) is no better than O(n log n).", what does "distinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (tính từ): khác nhau, không trùng. "Distinct values" = các giá trị không trùng nhau (như SELECT DISTINCT).
items.explanationEn: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (adjective): different from each other. "Distinct values" have no repeats, as in SQL SELECT DISTINCT.

items.question: Trong câu "It wins for large arrays of fixed-width integers — not a free lunch.", từ "free lunch" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It wins for large arrays of fixed-width integers — not a free lunch.", what does "free lunch" (phrase) mean?
options: lợi ích không phải trả giá
optionsEn: a meal you do not pay for
items.explanation: free lunch /ˌfriː ˈlʌntʃ/ (cụm từ): lợi ích không phải trả giá. Thành ngữ "There is no free lunch" = không có gì miễn phí, luôn phải đánh đổi.
items.explanationEn: free lunch /ˌfriː ˈlʌntʃ/ (phrase): a gain with no cost. The idiom "there is no free lunch" means every gain has a cost.

items.question: Trong câu "A sort is stable if elements with equal keys keep their original relative order.", từ "stable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sort is stable if elements with equal keys keep their original relative order.", what does "stable" (adjective) mean?
options: giữ nguyên thứ tự khi bằng nhau
items.explanation: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (tính từ): giữ nguyên thứ tự khi bằng nhau. "Stable sort" = sắp xếp ổn định; danh từ là "stability".
items.explanationEn: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (adjective): keeping equal items in order. A "stable sort" keeps equal keys in order; the noun is "stability".

items.question: Trong câu "A sort is stable if elements with equal keys keep their original relative order.", từ "relative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sort is stable if elements with equal keys keep their original relative order.", what does "relative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: relative /ˈrel.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): tương đối (so với nhau). "Relative order" = thứ tự của các phần tử so với nhau.
items.explanationEn: relative /ˈrel.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): compared with each other. "Relative order" is the order of items with respect to one another.

items.question: Trong câu "Radix sort — each pass must be stable, or the order from lower digits is destroyed.", từ "destroy" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Radix sort — each pass must be stable, or the order from lower digits is destroyed.", what does "destroy" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: destroy /dɪˈstrɔɪ/ (động từ): phá hỏng, làm mất. "Be destroyed" = bị phá hủy; ở đây thứ tự đã sắp bị mất.
items.explanationEn: destroy /dɪˈstrɔɪ/ (verb): to ruin completely. "Be destroyed" here means the earlier ordering is lost.

items.question: Trong câu "Merge sort is only stable if the merge takes from the left half on ties (<=, not <).", từ "tie" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Merge sort is only stable if the merge takes from the left half on ties (<=, not <).", what does "tie" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tie /taɪ/ (danh từ): trường hợp bằng nhau. "On ties" = khi hai giá trị bằng nhau; "a tie" trong thể thao là trận hòa.
items.explanationEn: tie /taɪ/ (noun): a case of equal values. "On ties" means when two values are equal; in sport a tie is a draw.

items.question: Trong câu "Since ES2019, Array.prototype.sort is required to be stable in every JavaScript engine.", từ "engine" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Since ES2019, Array.prototype.sort is required to be stable in every JavaScript engine.", what does "engine" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: engine /ˈen.dʒɪn/ (danh từ): bộ máy thực thi. "JavaScript engine" như V8, SpiderMonkey = chương trình chạy mã JS.
items.explanationEn: engine /ˈen.dʒɪn/ (noun): a program that runs code. A "JavaScript engine" such as V8 is the program that runs JS code.

items.question: Trong câu "getDigit uses Math.abs, so the basic version sorts by absolute value: [-5, 3, -1, 2] becomes [-1, 2, 3, -5].", từ "absolute value" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "getDigit uses Math.abs, so the basic version sorts by absolute value: [-5, 3, -1, 2] becomes [-1, 2, 3, -5].", what does "absolute value" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: absolute value /ˌæb.sə.luːt ˈvæl.juː/ (cụm từ): giá trị tuyệt đối. Giá trị tuyệt đối của -5 là 5; trong JS dùng Math.abs.
items.explanationEn: absolute value /ˌæb.sə.luːt ˈvæl.juː/ (phrase): size without sign. The absolute value of -5 is 5; in JS use Math.abs.

items.question: Trong câu "One fix is to sort the two signs separately:", từ "separately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One fix is to sort the two signs separately:", what does "separately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: separately /ˈsep.ər.ət.li/ (trạng từ): một cách riêng rẽ. Tính từ là "separate"; "handle X separately" = xử lý X riêng.
items.explanationEn: separately /ˈsep.ər.ət.li/ (adverb): apart from each other. The adjective is "separate"; "handle X separately" means on its own.

items.question: Trong câu "Another is to subtract the minimum from every value, sort, then add it back.", từ "subtract" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Another is to subtract the minimum from every value, sort, then add it back.", what does "subtract" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: subtract /səbˈtrækt/ (động từ): trừ đi. "Subtract A from B" = lấy B trừ A; danh từ là "subtraction".
items.explanationEn: subtract /səbˈtrækt/ (verb): to take away a number. "Subtract A from B" means B minus A; the noun is "subtraction".

items.question: Trong câu "Floats need their bit pattern, not decimal digits.", từ "decimal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Floats need their bit pattern, not decimal digits.", what does "decimal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: decimal /ˈdes.ɪ.məl/ (tính từ): thuộc hệ thập phân. "Decimal point" = dấu thập phân; "decimal digits" = chữ số 0–9.
items.explanationEn: decimal /ˈdes.ɪ.məl/ (adjective): based on ten. "Decimal digits" are 0–9; a "decimal point" separates fractions.

items.question: Trong câu "MSD radix sort starts from the most significant digit and recursively sorts each bucket, which suits variable-length strings.", từ "significant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MSD radix sort starts from the most significant digit and recursively sorts each bucket, which suits variable-length strings.", what does "significant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: significant /sɪɡˈnɪf.ɪ.kənt/ (tính từ): có giá trị hàng cao. "Most significant digit" = chữ số hàng cao nhất (bên trái cùng).
items.explanationEn: significant /sɪɡˈnɪf.ɪ.kənt/ (adjective): having the highest place value. The "most significant digit" is the leftmost, highest-value digit.

items.question: Trong câu "MSD radix sort starts from the most significant digit and recursively sorts each bucket, which suits variable-length strings.", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MSD radix sort starts from the most significant digit and recursively sorts each bucket, which suits variable-length strings.", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "X suits Y" = X hợp với Y; tính từ là "suitable".
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. "X suits Y" means X fits Y well; the adjective is "suitable".

items.question: Trong câu "When not to use it: small arrays, objects with a comparator, very long keys (large k), or tight memory — radix sort is not in-place.", từ "tight" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When not to use it: small arrays, objects with a comparator, very long keys (large k), or tight memory — radix sort is not in-place.", what does "tight" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tight /taɪt/ (tính từ): eo hẹp, hạn chế. "Tight memory/budget" = bộ nhớ/ngân sách eo hẹp.
items.explanationEn: tight /taɪt/ (adjective): limited, scarce. "Tight memory" or "tight budget" means very little is available.

items.question: Trong câu "When not to use it: small arrays, objects with a comparator, very long keys (large k), or tight memory — radix sort is not in-place.", từ "in-place" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When not to use it: small arrays, objects with a comparator, very long keys (large k), or tight memory — radix sort is not in-place.", what does "in-place" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: in-place /ˌɪnˈpleɪs/ (tính từ): ngay trên mảng gốc. "In-place algorithm" chỉ dùng O(1) bộ nhớ phụ, sửa trực tiếp mảng.
items.explanationEn: in-place /ˌɪnˈpleɪs/ (adjective): working inside the input. An "in-place algorithm" edits the input using O(1) extra memory.

items.question: Trong câu "Notes: bubble sort's O(n) best case needs the early-exit check.", từ "early exit" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Notes: bubble sort's O(n) best case needs the early-exit check.", what does "early exit" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: early exit /ˌɜː.li ˈek.sɪt/ (cụm từ): thoát sớm khỏi vòng lặp. Bubble sort dừng sớm nếu một lượt không có phép hoán đổi nào.
items.explanationEn: early exit /ˌɜː.li ˈek.sɪt/ (phrase): leaving a loop early. Bubble sort exits early when a pass makes no swaps.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick sort's space is the recursion stack — O(log n) on average, O(n) in the worst case unless you recurse into the smaller side first.", từ "stack" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick sort's space is the recursion stack — O(log n) on average, O(n) in the worst case unless you recurse into the smaller side first.", what does "stack" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stack /stæk/ (danh từ): ngăn xếp (lời gọi hàm). "Recursion stack" = ngăn xếp chứa các lời gọi đệ quy đang chờ.
items.explanationEn: stack /stæk/ (noun): a call-frame structure. The "recursion stack" holds pending recursive calls.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick sort's space is the recursion stack — O(log n) on average, O(n) in the worst case unless you recurse into the smaller side first.", từ "recurse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick sort's space is the recursion stack — O(log n) on average, O(n) in the worst case unless you recurse into the smaller side first.", what does "recurse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: recurse /rɪˈkɜːs/ (động từ): gọi đệ quy. Danh từ là "recursion"; "recurse into X" = gọi đệ quy trên phần X.
items.explanationEn: recurse /rɪˈkɜːs/ (verb): to call itself. The noun is "recursion"; "recurse into X" means call the function on X.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick sort's space is the recursion stack — O(log n) on average, O(n) in the worst case unless you recurse into the smaller side first.", từ "unless" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick sort's space is the recursion stack — O(log n) on average, O(n) in the worst case unless you recurse into the smaller side first.", what does "unless" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: unless /ənˈles/ (liên từ): trừ khi. "A unless B" = A xảy ra nếu không có B.
items.explanationEn: unless /ənˈles/ (conjunction): except if. "A unless B" means A happens if B does not.

items.question: Trong câu "In real JavaScript, use the built-in sort with a numeric comparator ((a, b) => a - b) — the default compares as strings.", từ "built-in" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In real JavaScript, use the built-in sort with a numeric comparator ((a, b) => a - b) — the default compares as strings.", what does "built-in" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (tính từ): có sẵn trong ngôn ngữ. "Built-in function" = hàm có sẵn, không cần cài thư viện.
items.explanationEn: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (adjective): provided by the language. A "built-in function" ships with the language.

items.question: Trong câu "In real JavaScript, use the built-in sort with a numeric comparator ((a, b) => a - b) — the default compares as strings.", từ "numeric" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In real JavaScript, use the built-in sort with a numeric comparator ((a, b) => a - b) — the default compares as strings.", what does "numeric" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: numeric /njuːˈmer.ɪk/ (tính từ): theo kiểu số. "Numeric comparator" so sánh giá trị số, không phải chuỗi.
items.explanationEn: numeric /njuːˈmer.ɪk/ (adjective): treating values as numbers. A "numeric comparator" compares numbers, not strings.

items.question: Trong câu "In real JavaScript, use the built-in sort with a numeric comparator ((a, b) => a - b) — the default compares as strings.", từ "comparator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In real JavaScript, use the built-in sort with a numeric comparator ((a, b) => a - b) — the default compares as strings.", what does "comparator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: comparator /kəmˈpær.ə.tər/ (danh từ): hàm so sánh. Comparator trả về số âm, 0 hoặc dương để quyết định thứ tự.
items.explanationEn: comparator /kəmˈpær.ə.tər/ (noun): a comparing function. A comparator returns a negative, zero or positive number to set order.

items.question: Trong câu "In real JavaScript, use the built-in sort with a numeric comparator ((a, b) => a - b) — the default compares as strings.", từ "default" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In real JavaScript, use the built-in sort with a numeric comparator ((a, b) => a - b) — the default compares as strings.", what does "default" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (danh từ): hành vi mặc định. "By default" = theo mặc định, khi không cấu hình gì thêm.
items.explanationEn: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (noun): the standard behaviour. "By default" means when nothing else is specified.

items.question: Trong câu "V8 uses TimSort, a merge/insertion hybrid: O(n log n) worst, O(n) on sorted input, stable, O(n) extra space.", từ "hybrid" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "V8 uses TimSort, a merge/insertion hybrid: O(n log n) worst, O(n) on sorted input, stable, O(n) extra space.", what does "hybrid" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hybrid /ˈhaɪ.brɪd/ (danh từ): sự kết hợp lai. "Hybrid approach" = cách kết hợp ưu điểm của nhiều phương pháp.
items.explanationEn: hybrid /ˈhaɪ.brɪd/ (noun): a mix of two things. A "hybrid approach" combines the strengths of several methods.

items.question: Trong câu "Non-comparison sorts (counting, radix, bucket) beat the bound by using the keys as indices, at the cost of generality and memory.", từ "at the cost of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Non-comparison sorts (counting, radix, bucket) beat the bound by using the keys as indices, at the cost of generality and memory.", what does "at the cost of" (phrase) mean?
options: nhờ vào sự hỗ trợ của
items.explanation: at the cost of /æt ðə ˈkɒst əv/ (cụm từ): với cái giá là mất. "Gain X at the cost of Y" = được X nhưng phải hy sinh Y.
items.explanationEn: at the cost of /æt ðə ˈkɒst əv/ (phrase): by giving up. "Gain X at the cost of Y" means Y is sacrificed for X.

items.question: Trong câu "Counting sort: O(n + k) time and space; great for small ranges, useless when k ≫ n.", từ "useless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Counting sort: O(n + k) time and space; great for small ranges, useless when k ≫ n.", what does "useless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: useless /ˈjuːs.ləs/ (tính từ): vô dụng. Trái nghĩa là "useful"; hậu tố "-less" nghĩa là "không có".
items.explanationEn: useless /ˈjuːs.ləs/ (adjective): of no use. The opposite is "useful"; the suffix "-less" means "without".

items.question: Trong câu "Counting sort counts occurrences of each value and writes them back in O(n + k).", từ "occurrence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Counting sort counts occurrences of each value and writes them back in O(n + k).", what does "occurrence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: occurrence /əˈkʌr.əns/ (danh từ): lần xuất hiện. Động từ là "occur"; "count occurrences" = đếm số lần xuất hiện.
items.explanationEn: occurrence /əˈkʌr.əns/ (noun): an instance of appearing. The verb is "occur"; "count occurrences" means count how often it appears.

items.question: Trong câu "Radix sort distributes integers into 10 buckets by each digit, from least to most significant, rebuilding the array after each pass.", từ "distribute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Radix sort distributes integers into 10 buckets by each digit, from least to most significant, rebuilding the array after each pass.", what does "distribute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: distribute /dɪˈstrɪb.juːt/ (động từ): phân chia vào các nhóm. "Distribute X into Y" = chia X vào các nhóm Y; danh từ "distribution".
items.explanationEn: distribute /dɪˈstrɪb.juːt/ (verb): to spread into groups. "Distribute X into Y" spreads X across Y; the noun is "distribution".

items.question: Trong câu "Its cost is O(nk) time and O(n + b) space; it shines for large arrays of fixed-width integers.", từ "shine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Its cost is O(nk) time and O(n + b) space; it shines for large arrays of fixed-width integers.", what does "shine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shine /ʃaɪn/ (động từ): phát huy hiệu quả tốt. "X shines for Y" (nghĩa bóng) = X đặc biệt tốt trong trường hợp Y.
items.explanationEn: shine /ʃaɪn/ (verb): to perform very well. Figuratively, "X shines for Y" means X is especially good at Y.

items.question: Trong câu "In everyday JavaScript, use the built-in stable sort with a proper comparator; choose specialised sorts when the data's shape allows it.", từ "specialised" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In everyday JavaScript, use the built-in stable sort with a proper comparator; choose specialised sorts when the data's shape allows it.", what does "specialised" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: specialised /ˈspeʃ.əl.aɪzd/ (tính từ): chuyên biệt cho một loại. Cách viết Anh-Anh; Anh-Mỹ là "specialized".
items.explanationEn: specialised /ˈspeʃ.əl.aɪzd/ (adjective): designed for one kind. British spelling; the American spelling is "specialized".
